summary: One blocker: the C-development analyzer records native-prefix hashes but does not validate them against the terminal teacher audit or join its teacher/audit inputs to the two fitted C results. Core tracker submission, pre-crop C action, common519 inputs, recipe/split and raw metric formulas pass source checks. No R3 runtime is certified.
blocking_scope: exact v2 prepared R3 source pipeline; no actual R2 or C result verdict

blocking_findings.title: Development comparison drops the audited teacher/native-prefix provenance chain
blocking_findings.details: Training binds its aggregate and replay-shard results to the terminal audit and records both teacher_result_sha256 and teacher_audit_sha256. The analyzer instead accepts a teacher root by completion status, exit code, spec and shared model-input metadata. It merely computes the current native_prefix.jsonl hash, without comparing it to an audited expected hash. It also never reads the fit results' teacher_result_sha256 or teacher_audit_sha256. Matching input/model metadata and comparing the two arms' common_dataset_sha256 do not establish that the native comparison trajectories came from the same audited teacher that produced the fit data. This is a concrete missing provenance join at the metric consumer; it is not an allegation that the unexecuted results are already corrupted.
blocking_findings.necessary_fix: Change only the new R3 analyzer: require the actual terminal R2 audit; require completed/zero-blocker/terminal-raw-audit flags; compare the aggregate SHA to audited_teacher_result_sha256; compare each native-prefix SHA to that same audit's per-shard native-prefix hashes; and require each fit result's teacher_result_sha256 and teacher_audit_sha256 to equal those exact inputs. The future terminal audit must emit the per-shard expected prefix hashes. Do not modify or restart the currently running R2 sources. Preserve this v2 report and source snapshots, then audit the revised R3 input version.

nonblocking_findings.title: Execution and final-result scope remain unproved
nonblocking_findings.details: The local launch receipt establishes a recorded R2 controller launch only. Its runtime_completion_proven is false; neither a terminal teacher result nor its raw-result audit is in this input inventory. The preparation receipt says no C construction, forward, optimization, deployment or GPU job. Source checks do not establish R2 completion, actual teacher sample counts, actual C initialization equality/updates/final weights, development32 inference, R4 own-history collection/final Full152 training, or any new formal nine metrics.

nonblocking_findings.title: C holdout and fixed-teacher utility have explicit claim limits
nonblocking_findings.details: The deterministic 120/32 split is a holdout for C optimization only: A+B trained on all152. The fixed development panel covers common eligible native-teacher write states, and its positive/negative/zero utility labels must not be assigned to changed C-policy histories. Own-history metrics provide geometric trajectory and write counts, not new W/K causal labels. Nonqualified actions have no teacher counterfactual labels. Report coverage and per-sequence gains/harms before any advance; the macro-IoU/H10 boolean is not the whole acceptance gate. Historical M82/category-only metadata in the immutable training_spec is not the current human-bank protocol or C recipe.

nonblocking_findings.details: All13 manifest Python sources and the26-file local import closure parse with Python3.8 grammar on the installed Python3.13 interpreter; 88 local imported symbols resolve statically. The three actual argparse fragments parse, including uppercase C_final/C_result. No new incompatible API is evident by source, but no Python3.8/Torch1.13.1 native import, model construction, CUDA operation, native-versus-new always-write trajectory comparison, or new source deployment was executed. Native library files, runtime package installation, target admission, assertion enablement and complete concrete R3 argv/source/weight/teacher-audit binding need their actual later receipts.

A_gt_provenance.scope: source only; all152 physical GT files and terminal teacher outputs not supplied
A_gt_provenance.details: Teacher collection uses legal first-box initialization and subsequent RGB/depth images without current/future GT selection. Replay finishes and saves W/K predicted trajectories before load_truth verifies per-sequence groundtruth.txt SHA, counts and first box; the historical toy07 1406-to1367 truncation is explicit. Current labels are real-GT current IoU; future labels are signed mean W-minus-K IoU over valid future frames. Both arms consume the same eligible cached C_input; only the label field differs. Deployment features are selected feature at t, feature at t-1, frozen first-frame RGB/depth/fused/CLIP reference, three predicted quality signals and four predicted-motion values. Current IoU and future rollouts/labels/images are absent from the C input and action. C inference never calls load_truth; the separate analyzer opens GT only after loading complete prediction artifacts.

B_score_normalization.scope: source formula and independent scalar checks; no actual NumPy metric execution
B_score_normalization.details: IoU divides geometric intersection by geometric union. Future utility is the mean signed IoU difference over dataset-valid future frames. Frame mean divides by the number of valid noninitialization GT frames; macro IoU is an equal mean of32 sequence means. H10 counts contiguous valid-GT IoU<=0.1 runs of at least10 frames and invalid GT breaks a run. Its original sequence frame indices remain zero-based half-open even though frame0 is excluded. No metric divides by a model-output maximum/minimum/mean. Feature normalization and decoder probability/native response ratios are inference transforms, not metric normalization. C never multiplies the submitted tracking score.

C_result_existence_and_binding.scope: one source provenance defect, no fabricated C result alleged
C_result_existence_and_binding.details: All22 manifest files plus the manifest/prepared receipt exist and match their original SHA/bytes. The historical P1 result has456 records in three152-sequence passes and consistent659406 calls,610128 supervised frames and20421 updates; this is internal receipt consistency, not an independent old-run rerun or binary-weight verification. Actual R2 launch is explicitly distinguished from completion. There are no supplied C weights, C completed-result files or new C metrics to validate, and the new contract explicitly makes no such claim. However B1 prevents the analyzer from certifying that its native comparison baseline is the exact terminal-audited teacher used for C fitting.

D_called_and_reached_code.scope: statically reachable code; no executed training/inference call graph
D_called_and_reached_code.details: train.main gates the teacher audit before TemplateWriteC construction, obtains common_samples, runs both label choices through the same forward/MSE/backward/AdamW loop, computes heldout teacher MSE and writes only the tenth-epoch final and its roundtrip/prediction receipts. evaluate.main obtains the bound frozen P1 context and invokes TrustedTemplateTracker.initialize/step for every noninitialization frame of all32 development sequences. The tracker calls write_features, writer and accepts_write only in the original qualified branch and crops the template only after acceptance. analyze.main reaches load_predictions, summarize->overlaps and fixed_panel, then serializes their results. Historical objective/optimizer functions imported transitively are not called by C inference; the historical OPE analyzer is a separate guarded entry point and produces no C metrics here. Missing native runtime/import receipts remain N3, not proof of dead metric code.

E_actual_vs_prospective_scope.scope: prepared source and historical launch records only
E_actual_vs_prospective_scope.details: The planned source scope is one seed2027, frozen P1, two70721-parameter C arms, common fit120/development32 data,10 epochs, batch32, AdamW3e-5/0.01 and a fixed final. The split has170436 fit and49366 development noninitialization frames; those are static video counts, not eligible teacher samples or executed C calls. No new C model was constructed or executed in this review. R2 terminal raw audit, target equivalence, actual two-arm training/evaluation, R4 own-history augmentation/Full152 final and one same-weight final nine-metric evaluation remain unsatisfied. No robustness, physical identity, language increment or crop-out recovery claim follows.

F_evaluation_classification.details: Prospective current IoU, future signed W/K utility, C teacher-MSE and complete own-history geometric development metrics are real_gt Train diagnostics. W/prefix and K/K equality are self_supervised_proxy consistency checks, not accuracy. Human text is fixed model input, not human_eval. Independent scalar audit fixtures and AST/parser checks are verification artifacts, not experiment results, training data or performance. The 32-frame action utility is not an independent identity truth or evidence of official benchmark success.
